name: Custom Volume Sampling via GLSL Injection
definition: A mechanism to override the default volume sampling logic by injecting a custom GLSL function into the fragment shader, allowing arbitrary scalar value calculation at voxel positions and time steps without requiring an atlas texture.
summary: Custom Volume Sampling via GLSL Injection overrides default volume sampling by injecting a user-defined GLSL function, decoupling data retrieval from texture fetches to enable dynamic, procedural volume evaluation.
